test_name: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring - CA-7 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Payments-Core-037
Primary NIST family: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring (CA); evidence focus: CA-7.
Environment: Azure. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: all open weaknesses are tracked in a POA&M with owners, milestones, and target dates. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
